name: Prosody Analysis
description: Supplements WhisperX transcription with prosodic features: pitch (F0) contour, speaking rate, voice quality (jitter/shimmer/HNR), and intensity. Uses parselmouth (Praat wrapper) — deterministic signal processing. Enriches the LLM's understanding of speaker emphasis, questions, energy shifts.

inputs.name: raw_footage_files
inputs.description: List of raw footage files to extract audio from

inputs.name: temporal_index
inputs.description: Temporal index with speech regions (used to identify voiced segments)

outputs.name: prosody_analysis
outputs.description: Per-clip prosody data: pitch contour, speaking rate, voice quality, intensity

preconditions: 'temporal_index' exists in state with speech regions
postconditions: 'prosody_analysis' is written to state with per-clip prosody data
